title: cli: should os verify fail like os validate on cloud capability tokens with no provider (exit parity)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing category: out-of-scope follow-up from objectstack#34726 (draft PR #35168, Acceptance notes; premise 6972083658), filed by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is open

`os validate` exits 1 on the 6 cloud capability tokens when no provider is installed; `os verify` (after #35168) only warns on the same tokens and exits 0. #34726 kept verify advisory on purpose (no new failing outcome on that card).

## Decide and do

Whether `os verify` should match `os validate`'s exit code for these tokens (a new failing outcome for existing projects), or the two commands' roles should be documented as different. If they should match: the exit change, a changeset naming it, and pins.
